slides.text: Pehli salary mein yeh 3 cheezein pehle karo
1. Emergency fund se shuru karo. Itna paisa alag rakho ki kuch mahine ka kharcha nikal sake.
2. Mahine ka kharcha likhna shuru karo. Pata chalega paisa jaata kahan hai.
3. Agar koi mehnga loan ya credit card ka balance hai toh use pehle utaaro.
Pehli salary par gadgets aur trips ka lalach hota hai. Thoda enjoy karo, par plan ke saath.
Kisi ke kehne par kisi stock ya scheme mein paisa mat lagao. Pehle basics samjho.
Paise ki aadat chhoti shuruaat se banti hai. Perfect plan ka intezaar mat karo.
Save karo. Pehli salary aane par dobara padhna.

caption:
Pehli salary ke baad kuch simple steps: emergency fund, kharcha track karo, mehnga loan pehle.
